bio.text: Tony Simone represents the 75th Assembly District, covering Chelsea, Hell's Kitchen, Midtown and part of the Lincoln Center area in Manhattan; he was elected to the Assembly in 2022.
Before that he was Director of External Affairs at Hudson River Park Friends.

Earlier in his career he was Director of Community Outreach for the New York City Council and Speaker Christine Quinn, and Deputy Director of the Northeast Regional Office of People for the American Way.
